Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, this is a blessed and fortunate day

Arabic text: وَ الْمُسْلِمُوْنَ فِيهِ مُجْتَمِعُونَ فِيْ أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ
Translation: And Muslims are gathered throughout Your lands

Arabic text: يَشْهَدُ السَّائِلُ مِنْهُمْ وَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الرَّاغِبُ وَ الرَّاهِبُ
Translation: The seekers, the petitioners, the hopeful, and the fearful are present
And You are the One who looks into their needs

Arabic text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ هَوَانِ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: So I ask You by Your generosity, Your nobility, and the ease with which You grant what I ask

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: That You send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ
Translation: And I ask You, O Allah, our Lord, for to You belongs the kingdom and to You belongs all praise

Arabic text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ
Translation: There is no god but You, the Forbearing, the Generous, the Compassionate, the Benefactor

Arabic text: ذُوْ الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ
Translation: Possessor of Majesty and Honor, Originator of the heavens and the earth
Whatever You distribute among Your believing servants

Arabic text: مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَرَكَةٍ أَوْ هُدًى أَوْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ
Translation: Of goodness, well-being, blessing, guidance, or deeds in Your obedience

Arabic text: أَوْ خَيْرٍ تَمُنُّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: Or any good which You bestow on them, guiding them to Yourself
Or by which You raise their ranks with You

Arabic text: أَوْ تُعْطِيهِمْ بِهِ خَيْرًا مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
Translation: Or by which You grant them good in this world and the hereafter

Arabic text: أَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّيْ وَ نَصِيبِيْ مِنْهُ
Translation: To increase my share and portion of it
And I ask You, O Allah, for
To You belongs the kingdom and the praise
There is no god but You
That You send blessings upon Muhammad
Your servant and Your messenger
Your beloved and Your chosen one
Your best selection from Your creation

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَبْرَارِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ
Translation: And upon the family of Muhammad, the righteous, the pure, the excellent

Arabic text: صَلَاةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Translation: Blessings that none can count except You
And that You include us among

Arabic text: صَالِحِ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فِيْ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
Translation: The righteous ones who call upon You on this day
From among Your believing servants
O Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَ لَهُمْ
Translation: And that You forgive us and them
Verily, You have power over all things
O Allah, to You I have directed my need
And with You I have placed today my poverty
My destitution and my lowliness

Arabic text: وَ إِنِّيْ بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ أَوْثَقُ مِنِّيْ بِعَمَلِي
Translation: And I am more confident in Your forgiveness and mercy than in my deeds

Arabic text: وَ لَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
Translation: And Your forgiveness and mercy are greater than my sins

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَ تَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ هِيَ لِي
Translation: And take charge of fulfilling all my needs
By Your power over them
And the ease with which You can do this
And by my need for You
And Your independence from me

Arabic text: فَإِنِّيْ لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْرًا قَطُّ إِلَّا مِنْكَ
Translation: For I have never received any good except from You

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّيْ سُوءًا قَطُّ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ
Translation: And no one has ever averted evil from me except You
And I do not hope for the affairs
Of my hereafter and my world from anyone but You
O Allah, whoever has prepared and made ready
And equipped and readied themselves
For a visit to a created being

Arabic text: رَجَاءَ رِفْدِهِ وَ نَوَافِلِهِ وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِهِ وَ جَائِزَتِهِ
Translation: Hoping for their support, gifts, and seeking their prize and reward
It is to You, O my Master, that today
I have prepared and made myself ready
And equipped and readied myself
Hoping for Your pardon and Your support
And seeking Your gift and Your reward

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُخَيِّبِ الْيَوْمَ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ رَجَائِي
Translation: And do not disappoint my hope today
O You whom no petitioner can exhaust
And whom no gift can diminish
For I have not come to You with confidence
In any righteous deed I have done
Nor hoping for the intercession of any created being

Arabic text: إِلَّا شَفَاعَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
Translation: Except the intercession of Muhammad and his family
Upon him and upon them be Your peace

Arabic text: أَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرًّا بِالْجُرْمِ وَ الْإِسَاءَةِ إِلَى نَفْسِي
Translation: I come to You admitting my sins and wrongdoing against myself
I come to You hoping for Your great pardon
By which You have pardoned the sinners

Arabic text: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ
Translation: Then their long persistence in grave sins did not prevent You

Arabic text: أَنْ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
Translation: From turning to them with mercy and forgiveness
O One whose mercy is vast
And whose pardon is great
O Great One, O Great One
O Generous One, O Generous One

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And turn to me with Your mercy
And be kind to me with Your grace
And be generous to me with Your forgiveness

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَقَامَ لِخُلَفَائِكَ وَ أَصْفِيَائِكَ
Translation: O Allah, this position belongs to Your caliphs and Your chosen ones
And the stations of Your trustees

Arabic text: فِيْ الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ الَّتِيْ اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ بِهَا
Translation: In the exalted rank with which You have distinguished them
They have been usurped
And You are the One who ordained this
Your command cannot be overcome

Arabic text: وَ لَا يُجَاوَزُ الْمَحْتُومُ مِنْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
Translation: And what is inevitable in Your arrangement cannot be transgressed
However You will and whenever You will
And for whatever purpose You know best

Arabic text: غَيْرُ مُتَّهَمٍ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لَا لِإِرَادَتِكَ
Translation: You are not questioned about Your creation or Your will
Until Your chosen ones and Your caliphs
Became defeated, overpowered, and dispossessed
They see Your judgments altered
And Your Book cast aside

Arabic text: وَ فَرَائِضَكَ مُحَرَّفَةً عَنْ جِهَاتِ أَشْرَاعِكَ
Translation: And Your obligations distorted from the directions of Your laws
And the traditions of Your Prophet abandoned

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ
Translation: O Allah, curse their enemies from the first to the last
And those who are pleased with their actions
And their followers and their adherents

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
Surely You are Praiseworthy, Glorious
Like Your blessings, benedictions, and greetings

Arabic text: عَلَى أَصْفِيَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
Translation: Upon Your chosen ones, Abraham and the family of Abraham
And hasten the relief

Arabic text: وَ الرَّوْحَ وَ النُّصْرَةَ وَ التَّمْكِينَ وَ التَّأْيِيدَ لَهُمْ
Translation: And comfort and victory and empowerment and support for them
O Allah, and make me
Among the people of monotheism
And faith in You
And belief in Your Messenger
And the Imams whose obedience You have made obligatory

Arabic text: مِمَّنْ يَجْرِيْ ذٰلِكَ بِهِ وَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
Translation: Among those through whom and by whose hands this is carried out
Amen, O Lord of the worlds

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلَّا حِلْمُكَ
Translation: O Allah, nothing repels Your anger except Your forbearance

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَرُدُّ سَخَطَكَ إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ
Translation: And nothing repels Your displeasure except Your pardon

Arabic text: وَ لَا يُجِيرُ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ
Translation: And nothing protects from Your punishment except Your mercy
And nothing saves me from You

Arabic text: إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
Translation: Except pleading to You and before You

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَ هَبْ لَنَا يَا إِلَهِيْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَرَجًا
Translation: And grant us, O my God, from Your presence, relief

Arabic text: بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِيْ بِهَا تُحْيِيْ أَمْوَاتَ الْعِبَادِ
Translation: By the power with which You revive the dead among Your servants
And by which You restore dead lands

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِيْ يَا إِلَهِيْ غَمًّا
Translation: And do not destroy me, O my God, with grief
Until You answer me
And make me recognize the response to my prayer

Arabic text: وَ أَذِقْنِيْ طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي
Translation: And let me taste the flavor of well-being until the end of my life
And do not let my enemy rejoice over me
And do not give him power over my neck
And do not let him dominate me
My God, if You raise me up
Who is it that can bring me down?
And if You bring me down
Who is it that can raise me up?
And if You honor me
Who is it that can humiliate me?
And if You humiliate me
Who is it that can honor me?
And if You punish me
Who is it that can have mercy on me?
And if You destroy me

Arabic text: فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِيْ عَبْدِكَ
Translation: Who is it that can intercede with You concerning Your servant
Or ask You about his affair?

Arabic text: وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِيْ حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
Translation: And I know that there is no injustice in Your judgment
And no haste in Your vengeance

Arabic text: وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ
Translation: Only he hastens who fears missing his chance

Arabic text: وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ
Translation: And only the weak needs to resort to injustice
But You, O my God, are far exalted
Above all that, a great exaltation

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And do not make me a target for affliction
Nor a focus for Your vengeance
And grant me respite, and relieve me
And forgive my stumbling
And do not afflict me with trial
Upon trial
For You see my weakness
And my lack of means
And my pleading to You

Arabic text: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ
Translation: I seek refuge with You, O Allah, today from Your anger

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِذْنِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and protect me

Arabic text: وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
Translation: And I seek Your shelter today from Your displeasure

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَجِرْنِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and shelter me
And I ask You for security from Your punishment

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ آمِنِّي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and secure me
And I ask You for guidance

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اهْدِنِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and guide me
And I ask for Your help

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ انْصُرْنِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and help me
And I ask for Your mercy

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ ارْحَمْنِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and have mercy on me
And I ask for Your sufficiency

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اكْفِنِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and suffice me
And I ask for Your provision

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ ارْزُقْنِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and provide for me
And I ask for Your assistance

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِنِّي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and assist me

Arabic text: وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
Translation: And I ask Your forgiveness for my past sins

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and forgive me
And I ask for Your protection

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اعْصِمْنِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and protect me

Arabic text: فَإِنِّيْ لَنْ أَعُودَ لِشَيْءٍ كَرِهْتَهُ مِنِّيْ إِنْ شِئْتَ ذَلِكَ
Translation: For I will not return to anything You dislike from me, if You will that

Arabic text: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ
Translation: O Lord, O Lord, O Compassionate, O Benefactor
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And answer for me all
That I have asked You and sought from You
And desired from You

Arabic text: وَ أَرِدْهُ وَ قَدِّرْهُ وَ اقْضِهِ وَ أَمْضِهِ
Translation: And will it and ordain it and decree it and carry it out

Arabic text: وَ خِرْ لِيْ فِيمَا تَقْضِيْ مِنْهُ
Translation: And choose what is best for me in what You decree
And bless me in that
And be gracious to me with it
And make me happy with what You give me of it
And increase for me from Your bounty
And the abundance of what You have
For You are Vast, Generous

Arabic text: وَ صِلْ ذٰلِكَ بِخَيْرِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ نَعِيمِهَا
Translation: And connect that with the good of the hereafter and its bliss
O Most Merciful of the merciful
